mapper.sql: select a.achievement_id as "achievementId", concat('SG-', a.achievement_id) as "managementNo", personnel.name as "teacherName", a.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", a.organization_code as "organizationCode", a.occurred_date as "occurredDate", a.guidance_start_date as "guidanceStartDate", a.guidance_end_date as "guidanceEndDate", a.student_count as "studentCount", a.achievement_detail as "achievementDetail", a.certification_status as "certificationStatus", a.attachment_ref as "attachmentRef", a.updated_at as "updatedAt", a.updated_by as "updatedBy" from student_guidance_achievements a join users u on u.user_id=a.created_by join korus_personnel_snapshots personnel on personnel.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: where a.deleted_yn='N' order by a.occurred_date desc, a.achievement_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from student_guidance_achievements where deleted_yn='N'
mapper.update: update student_guidance_achievements set management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode},organization_code=#{request.organizationCode},occurred_date=#{request.occurredDate},guidance_start_date=#{request.guidanceStartDate},guidance_end_date=#{request.guidanceEndDate},student_count=#{request.students.size},achievement_detail=#{request.achievementDetail},attachment_ref=#{request.attachmentRef},certification_status=#{request.certificationStatus},updated_at=current_timestamp,updated_by=#{userId},change_reason=#{request.changeReason} where achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} and deleted_yn='N'
mapper.select: select student_no as "studentNo",student_name as "studentName" from student_guidance_students where achievement_id=#{achievementId} order by student_guidance_student_id

select count(*) from student_guidance_students s join student_guidance_achievements a on a.achievement_id=s.achievement_id where s.student_no=#{studentNo} and a.occurred_date=#{occurredDate} and a.deleted_yn='N'
